modules.module_title: Mechanism of Jute Winding, beaming, sizing, weaving and finishing

pcs.pc_description: Explain Yarn Quality for different end product
Explain Jute Winding / Beaming machine and identification of parts
Explain Jute Sizing and its necessity
Recommend yarn count of the spool (ask side beamers to follow the colour mark)
Perform measurement of machine performance at weaving preparatory section
Count and set the exact number of threads or runners at the start for a particular quality of beam (needed for a specified fabric) and continue frequent checking
Carry out correct take up of sizing paste by the yarn and squeezing properly, adjust the pressing roller accordingly
Carry out clean surface of the steam cylinders, correct steam pressure to get proper Drying of yarn

Carry out moisture content (30%-35% for sackings & 18% -22% for hessian) & 1.5-2 % size application in beam in consultation with superiors as practiced in jute industry and ensure 70%. wet pick-up of size
Check the steam pressure to keep it at 25-35 psi and put right identification mark for its quality
Control manually the beam speed to maintain right yarn tension in jute beaming machine
Align the warp yarns on the extreme selvedge so that these warp yarns do not fall on flanges or wrap over the flanges

Carry out man and machine safety while operating the beaming machine, and keep the working place (floor) clean i.e. free from any unwanted elements like spool centre, thread waste, broken machine parts etc.
Carry out the weavers knot is of minimum size to pass easily through the heald wires and reed
Carry out that all the stop motions, indication lamps , preventive mechanisms etc., function properly
Explain Loom Motions and its classification, Identification and function of required tools, equipment, and consumables needed for the Production.
Be able to draw the mended warp yarn through the healds properly , as per the drawing order prescribed

Correct the fabric defects like wrong drawing, wrong denting, end out , double end etc., immediately and also ensure that the other fabric defects too are corrected at the earliest, before continuing further production
Rectify in case of any floats, should be able to " unweave " the same & should be able to run the machine without " starting mark or 1crack"
Carry out that cloth rolls are doffed whenever/ wherever necessary
